# `aitbc exchange node register`

Claim this node's seeded registry row with a signed envelope.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc exchange node register [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name or file path — the node's registered AIT wallet |
| `--label` | text | — | no | Registry label (must equal the seeded label; default: use seeded) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Envelope chain_id (default: island credentials) |
| `--exchange-url` | text | — | no | Override exchange service base URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc exchange node register
```
